citations.line: The accident investigation into INC-2005-003 recommended that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment be strengthened in this procedure.
The engineering change note record for this revision cites INC-2005-003 as the reason the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was amended.
Revision 1 was raised in response to INC-2005-003, and the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was amended as a result.
Revision 1 was raised in response to NM-2005-0008, and the secondary containment by bund and drainage was amended as a result.
